name: Meripri: The Tale of The Prince and Mermaid
source:
Once upon a time there was a king who was tricked into promising his first born to a wicked mermaid. To protect the prince the king sends him away to a distant kingdom but will that be enough to save him?

[From [url=https://studio8486.itch.io/meripri]Itch.io[/url]]
